US Official Downplays 'War' Status Amid Iran Tensions

US Vice President JD Vance stated that the US is not engaged in a "war" in Iran, asserting there is "no active shooting." This statement came as tensions in the region escalated, with Iran claiming an airstrike hit a wedding party, an incident the US is reportedly probing. Vance also indicated that the US would not engage in talks with Iran until attacks in the Strait of Hormuz cease. Separately, reports emerged concerning hazard pay and tax breaks for military personnel killed in the Middle East, with one widow being initially told these benefits would not apply because the US was "not at war."
